lostDialog.title: I no longer have it
lostDialog.description: The {store} copy stays in the history with its type and its date.
lostDialog.date: Date (if you leave it empty, we use today)

rows.title: Where and how you have it
rows.name: Copy {number}

notInterested.text: You have it but don’t plan to play it: it doesn’t show up in the library or in the counts. You see it with “Show not interested”.

releaseYear.text: The year the game came out, not the year you got it.

duration.text: How long it takes on average to finish it, according to IGDB or what you enter. It’s not your hours played.

family.text: Someone in your Steam family lends it to you: you can play it, but it isn’t yours.

other.text: For what doesn’t fit the other types, like a gift. It counts as yours.

manual.text: You added it yourself because it wasn’t on IGDB. Only you see it, and you can link it to IGDB whenever you want.

lost.text: You no longer have this copy, for example because you sold it or the subscription ended. The game keeps its status, its score and its hours.

endless.text: A game that doesn’t end, like a multiplayer one: it has no estimated length.

filters.endlessHint: “Endless” games have no length and are left out of this filter.
filters.title: Filters

dialog.finishedNote: We save today’s date as the end date. You can score it afterwards.
dialog.note: The change is recorded with today’s date.

library.title: Library
library.summary: {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} in {stores, plural, one {# store} other {# stores}} · {wishlist} in “Want to play” · {lost} you no longer have
library.empty: You haven’t added any games yet.
library.noResults: No games match this combination of filters.

playedDialog.title: Hours played
playedDialog.description: The total you played. If you enter it, it counts more than what the stores say.

edit.title: Edit
edit.description: Your changes only show in your library. Leave a field empty to use the catalog’s data.

cover.label: Cover (optional)
cover.hint: If you don’t add one, we use the initials.

link.title: Link to IGDB
link.description: The game takes IGDB’s data and keeps your status, your score, your copies and your history.
link.noResults: We couldn’t find that game on IGDB.

admin.removeDescription: {title} is deleted with its copies, its score and its history. This can’t be undone.

removeCopy.title: Delete copy
removeCopy.description: The {store} copy is deleted without a trace. If you lost it, better mark it “I no longer have it”.

login.title: Sign in to your library
login.text: Your games, your stores and your subscriptions, in one place.

nav.searchPlaceholder: Do I have it? Search for a game…
nav.loadError: We couldn’t load your data. Try again.

notFound.title: We couldn’t find that screen
notFound.text: The link may be wrong, or the screen may no longer exist.

add.title: Add game
add.subtitle: Search for it on IGDB. If it doesn’t show up, add it by hand in the panel on the right.
add.searchHint: We search IGDB as you type.

invite.title: Not there?
invite.text: Games from itch.io, game jams, mods or anything else: add it by hand with a title, link and cover.

add.manualTitle: Not there? Add it by hand
add.manualSubtitle: For indies from itch.io, game jams or mods.

manualPage.title: Add by hand
manualPage.subtitle: For games that aren’t on IGDB: indies from itch.io, game jams, mods.

igdbDialog.title: Add “{title}”
